verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for a public government web service like impots.gouv.fr, so the axis applies. None of the evidence items, which are homepage and professional-section navigation snippets, mentions a robots.txt file or any crawler-access policy, so there is no evidence the service delivers this.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
